svg.title: The Lantern Keeper of Willow Marsh
svg.desc: A fantasy-illustration page combines long curling tentacles, dramatic thin-versus-heavy silhouettes, layered organic surfaces and a theatrical figure high above elaborate creatures. The new dragon uses the serpentine construction and etched surface rhythm, with an original gentle story. Exactly 7.000 s, continuous loop: 0–0.84 s poised breath; 0.84–1.68 s foreleg lowers 3° and sails compress; 1.68–3.78 s lantern foreleg lifts −7°, near sail opens −12°, head bows 5°; 3.78–5.04 s warm presentation hold, lantern swings back with delayed follow-through; 5.04–7.00 s wing, head and claw recover continuously. Lantern and fireflies have seven-second subsidiary tracks with matching endpoints.
svg.text: THE LANTERN KEEPER OF WILLOW MARSH
